hook_text: 936 divided by 12. Halve both numbers and it becomes easy.
clip_script: Sports day near Brits. R936 prize money shared among 12 classes. Guess first: 960 divided by 12 is 80, so about R80 each. Now make it easy. Halve both numbers: 468 divided by 6. 420 divided by 6 is 70. 48 divided by 6 is 8. R78 each. Check by multiplying back: 78 times 12 is 936. Now 945 water bottles, 15 to a box. Double both: 1 890 divided by 30. That is 63 boxes. Never split the number you divide by. Guess, change it, check it.
visual_style: A pile of prize money and a row of class flags both halving together, then bottles doubling into crates of 30.
mood: Clever and confident, like a sports organiser with everything under control.
pacing: Estimate, halve, solve, check, then the doubling twist.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out 864 divided by 16 by halving both numbers.
